articles.title: Password Reset and Account Recovery
articles.content: To reset your password, navigate to the login screen and click 'Forgot Password'. You will receive an automated recovery link valid for 30 minutes. If you do not see the email, check your spam or quarantine folder. Accounts locked after 5 consecutive failed attempts will automatically unlock after 15 minutes, or you can contact an administrator for immediate unlock.

articles.title: Billing Cycles, Invoicing and Tax Details
articles.content: Subscription billing runs on either a monthly or annual cadence starting on the day of activation. Invoices are generated automatically on the first day of each billing cycle with full VAT and GST breakdown. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated charges, while downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period. Invoices can be downloaded as PDF from Settings > Billing > Invoices.

articles.title: Refund Policy and Cancellation Windows
articles.content: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for all new annual subscriptions from the initial purchase date. Monthly plans are eligible for a refund within 48 hours of charge if zero API or seat activity occurred. To request a refund or reimbursement, email billing support with your transaction reference. Refunds are processed back to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.

articles.title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup and Recovery
articles.content: Two-factor authentication (2FA / MFA) adds an extra layer of security using TOTP apps like Google Authenticator or 1Password. To enable 2FA, go to Profile > Security > Enable 2FA, scan the QR code, and store the 10 emergency recovery codes in a secure offline location. If you lose your authenticator device, enter one of the one-time recovery codes to sign in and reset your 2FA credentials.

articles.title: User Roles, Permissions and Team Invitations
articles.content: Workspaces support three user roles: Owner, Admin, and Agent. Owners have full billing and deletion authority. Admins can manage integrations, invite team members, and modify knowledge base articles. Agents can answer conversations, view stats, and access public articles. To invite teammates, navigate to Settings > Team > Invite Agent and provide their email address.

articles.title: Single Sign-On Configuration with SAML and Okta
articles.content: Enterprise workspaces can enforce Single Sign-On (SSO) using SAML 2.0 identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, or Google Workspace. Configure your IdP with the ACS URL and Entity ID provided under Settings > Security > SSO. Once configured, you can enable 'Enforce SSO' to require all domain members to authenticate via your identity provider.

articles.title: API Rate Limits, Quotas and Webhook Retries
articles.content: Standard REST API access is limited to 120 requests per minute per API key. When a client exceeds the limit, the server responds with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests and a Retry-After header. Webhook deliveries use an exponential backoff retry mechanism (10s, 30s, 2m, 10m, 1h) before marking the webhook delivery as failed after 5 attempts.

articles.title: Data Export, Retention Schedules and GDPR Compliance
articles.content: Workspace owners can request a complete data export in JSON format under Settings > Compliance > Export Data. Data archives contain all conversations, customer profiles, and knowledge base articles. By default, customer conversation logs are retained for 365 days unless a custom retention policy is configured. GDPR Right-to-be-Forgotten erasure requests are fulfilled within 30 days.

articles.title: Custom Domains and SSL Certificate Provisioning
articles.content: You can host your customer support portal on a custom domain (e.g. support.yourcompany.com). To set up, add a CNAME record pointing your subdomain to host.cognidesk.com. CogniDesk automatically provisions and renews a free Let's Encrypt SSL/TLS certificate within 60 minutes of DNS propagation.

articles.title: Plan Downgrades, Feature Retention and Grace Periods
articles.content: When downgrading from a paid plan to the Free tier, premium features such as AI suggested replies and custom domains remain active until the end of the prepaid billing cycle. Historical conversation transcripts and articles are preserved in read-only mode. If team members exceed the free seat limit of 3, extra agent accounts are suspended after a 7-day grace period.

articles.title: Email Notification Preferences and Digest Frequency
articles.content: Agents can configure notification alerts for new incoming conversations, unassigned chats, and customer mentions. Delivery options include real-time browser push notifications, instant emails, or a daily digest summary sent at 09:00 AM local time. Configure these preferences in Profile > Notifications.

articles.title: Workspace Ownership Transfer and Reassignment
articles.content: Only the current Workspace Owner can transfer primary ownership to another existing Admin. To initiate transfer, go to Settings > Workspace > Transfer Ownership, select the destination administrator, and confirm with your password. The transfer is instantaneous and downgrades the previous owner to Admin status.

articles.title: Audit Logs, Activity Tracking and Security Events
articles.content: Audit logs record all significant security and administrative actions, including agent logins, role changes, knowledge base modifications, and export requests. Logs include timestamps, actor IP address, user agent, and action payload. Enterprise customers can stream audit events to external SIEM platforms or export CSV logs from Settings > Security > Audit Logs.

articles.title: IP Whitelisting and Network Access Restrictions
articles.content: Restrict access to your workspace by specifying allowed IPv4 and IPv6 addresses or CIDR blocks under Settings > Security > IP Whitelist. When enabled, any connection or login attempt from an unlisted IP address is rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden. We recommend adding at least two administrator IPs to avoid accidental lockout.

articles.title: File Attachment Limits, Quotas and Supported Formats
articles.content: Customers and agents can attach files up to 25 MB per upload. Supported file types include PNG, JPG, PDF, TXT, CSV, and DOCX. Executable files (EXE, BAT, SH) are strictly blocked for security. Total workspace storage capacity depends on tier: 5 GB for Starter, 50 GB for Professional, and 500 GB for Enterprise.
